items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: We played for the carnival, remember? With Thomas Copeland. Yeah. I played snare drum

ctx.x: Did you play bass drum or snare drum on the stage?

I could play any of them, but I didn't care for them. I'm a daddy too, I just never did care for them. I played a parade twice. We played for the carnival, remember? With Thomas Copeland. Yeah. I played snare drum and what you call him?
We played for the Arabi packing company, the Arabi packing company. Maurice Duran, Thomas Copeland. Who's band running? Thomas Copeland.
